table.retrieve:
SELECT  patientcode ,
        Regno,
			name ,
			ward,
			gender,
			active,
			fname,
			dob,
			custcode,
			usercode,
			date,
			NationalIDCard,
			phone,
			fax,
			email,
			rankcode,
			unitcode,
			address1,
			address2,
			city,
			Age=DATEDIFF(YYYY, DOB, GETDATE()),
			MobileNo1 = MobileNo1,
			MobileNo2 = MobileNo2,
			MobileNo3 = MobileNo3
         
FROM patient      
WHERE ( patientcode = :ra_patientcode )
